skill.summary: 在抖音创作者平台发布短视频。触发场景：发布抖音视频、上传抖音视频、抖音发布视频、发抖音视频。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – supports automated Douyin (TikTok China) short video posting with full UI operation steps.

- Enables video upload, title & description input, cover selection, collection choice, and AI declaration on Douyin Creator Platform.
- Uses OpenClaw Chrome browser for all automated web actions; start and navigate via specified commands.
- Includes detailed automation steps for file selection using pyautogui and tkinter, supporting Chinese file paths.
- Ensures each topic/tag is added and confirmed via on-screen selection for correct addition.
- Sets permission controls and AI content declaration as required.
- Saves video as draft with "暂存离开" instead of immediate publishing.
